【压缩传输】开启后可减少带宽开销，但会增加CPU开销，如带宽充足，建议关闭此选项: [Compressed transmission] can reduce bandwidth overhead when turned on, but will increase CPU overhead. If the bandwidth is sufficient, it is recommended to turn this option off.
【同步方式】增量： 数据更改/增加时同步，且只追加和替换文件\\n【同步方式】完: [Synchronization mode] Incremental: synchronizes when data is changed/increased, and only appends and replaces files\n[Synchronization mode] Complete: maintains the consistency of the data and directory structure at both ends, and deletes, appends, and replaces files and directories synchronously
【同步目录】若不以/结尾，则表示将数据同步到二级目录，一般情况下目录路径请以/结: [Synchronization Directory] If it does not end with /, it means the data will be synchronized to the secondary directory. Generally, the directory path should end with /.
【延迟】在延迟时间周期内仅记录不同步，到达周期后一次性同步数据，以节省开销: [Delay] Only record out-of-synchronization during the delay time period, and synchronize the data once after the period is reached to save overhead.
【限速】限制数据同步任务的速度，防止因同步数据导致带宽跑高: [Speed ​​Limit] Limit the speed of data synchronization tasks to prevent high bandwidth due to data synchronization.
如果开启防火墙,需要放行873端口: If you enable the firewall, you need to allow port 873
